pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpetvā Aciravatiyā nadiyā vesiyāhi saddhiṃ naggā ekatitthe nhāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.4: hi nāma bhikkhuniyo sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpessanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tāsaṃ vesiyānaṃ ujjhāyantīnaṃ --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā tā ujjhāyanti --pa--: kathaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.7: hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo . . . saṃharāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo . . . saṃharāpessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:2.8: ekam pi lomaṃ saṃharāpeti, āpatti pācittiyassa,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc2:2.9: bahuke pi lome saṃharāpeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
